abstract: We report here a case of very late relapse of a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor 21 years after first complete remission. A 42-year-old man, with a clinical history of right testicular cancer, was referred to our hospital with elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) level. CT scan demonstrated a 5 x 5 cm retroperitoneal lymph node swelling compressing the inferior vena cava (IVC) extending from the right renal vein down to the bifurcation of the aorta. The patient received a total of four courses of combination chemotherapy consisting of cisplatin, etoposide, paxlitaxel, and ifosfamide. However, the retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis did not respond to chemotherapy, and the serum AFP level increased. Extended bilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with right nephrectomy, partial duodenectomy, and vena cavectomy were performed. The patient has been followed up with no evidence of disease for 48 months after the operation without any further therapy.
abstract_ja: 右精巣がんに対して初回完全寛解を得てから21年後に、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が極めて晩期に再発した症例を報告する。42歳男性が、血清αフェトプロテイン（AFP）上昇を主訴に当院を受診した。CT上、右腎静脈から大動脈分岐部まで伸展し下大静脈を圧迫する5×5cmの後腹膜リンパ節腫大を認めた。シスプラチン、エトポシド、パクリタキセル、イホスファミドによる併用化学療法を計4コース施行したが、後腹膜リンパ節転移は化学療法に反応せず、AFP値は上昇した。右腎摘除術、部分十二指腸切除術、下大静脈切除術を伴う拡大両側後腹膜リンパ節郭清術を施行した。術後48か月間、無病の状態で経過している。
